def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """Reverses the order of elements while keeping each punctuation mark

    attached to its original position (or rather, reversing the punctuation
    list along with the elements so they swap relative ends).
    """
    # Reverse both lists to achieve the desired effect
    new_elements = elements[::-1]
    new_punctuation = punctuation[::-1]

    return new_elements, new_punctuation
